description: Hierarchical outline of every definition in a file, with signatures — read the structure of a file without reading its source. Pass a DIRECTORY instead of a file to get its public API surface in one call rather than one call per file. Over budget, nesting depth is shed before any top-level symbol is dropped, so the shape stays honest. Set include_docs to also get first-line doc comments.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

exported_only.description: directories default to true (public API surface); files default to false

max_depth.description: cap nesting depth; members below it collapse into a (+N members) count

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path.description: file OR directory path, relative to the workspace root

name: get_file_outline
title: File outline
